1/0/0.heading: Take Program
1/0/0.body: Cuts the current preview bus to program. This is the main "go live" trigger for the show.

1/0/1.heading: Standby
1/0/1.body: Parks the switcher on the standby slate between segments.
1/0/1.notice: Do not use during a live segment — this will cut to black on air.

1/1/0.heading: Program Mute
1/1/0.note: Toggle, not momentary — check the tally before walking away.

1/2/4.heading: Lower Third
1/2/4.body: Shows the current speaker's lower-third graphic.

2/1/5.heading: Overlay Toggle
2/1/5.body: Shows/hides the vMix overlay channel used for sponsor bugs.

2/3/7.heading: All Stop
2/3/7.body: Kills every running OSC cue across all connections — the panic button.
2/3/7.notice: Use only if a cue is stuck or misfiring; this does not just pause, it stops everything.
